supply chain and portfolio alignment is a promising approach to reduce supply chain costs, but that the potential is hard to realize in practice.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
supply chain design should not be considered in isolation from the product design process, and that supply chain and production network design should be considered jointly.
supply chain and portfolio management are two sides of the same coin.
firms should not only consider the product portfolio when designing their supply chains, but also the other way around.

supply chain and portfolio alignment is an essential part of supply chain management.
the optimal supply chain portfolio is not necessarily a one-size-fits-all solution.
firms should carefully consider their product-to-supply-chain alignment in order to maximize their cost efficiency.
